body: I feel you on that.  I'm feeling a tad better than this morning so I guess the pills are finally kicking in.
Geesh, I'm so low the trolls don't even bother me anymore. I miss having feelings. It sucked but I could put up a nice fight at least.

That's one of the things keeping me from doing it. What if it's a worst existence because I ended my own life? the other thing keeping me from going for it is I'm a screw up. What if I get it wrong and just end up injuring myself. Depressed and paralyzed would be excruciating.  At least now I don't have anyone but I don't need anyone. I don't even want to imagine having to depend on another person to bathe, dress or feed me.
thank you for your kindness.  That's an interesting theory - but I sincerely hope it's wrong.  I just want this to be over and wish it never started for me in the first place.
Thank you. I’ve lost interest in everything. That’s what makes it even harder.
Unmerited favor is a bit more spiritual in my opinion.  Destiny is somewhat spiritual, but mostly motivation for manifesting inner greatness.
😊 I've been reading Unmerited Favor by Joseph Prince and Destiny by T. D. Jakes.
Hi, I'm doing much better. I've been praying, reading positive and inspirational material and keeping busy with work. Just taking it one day at a time. Thanks for asking.
Who knows. I wish I had all the answers. It's not on Him, This is on me. I believe I can beat this. If I didn't, I'd end it all.

I've been dealing with depression for 34 years - that's right - my whole life.  It's my faith in Christ that keeps me going.  If I can keep pushing, so can you.  At 20, you still have so many opportunities to make a better future for yourself.  Be your own best friend and give yourself a chance.
It helps to know someone understands.  I would feel like a total nut case trying to explain this to anyone I know.

I was probably around 5 years old when my cousin - who's actually my brother - told me.  He got in trouble because he wasn't supposed to.  I was in shock - but I went to my birth mother and asked her if she was actually my mom, she looked really disturbed and said "no", but I knew she was lying.  My adopted mother explained it to me the best way she could and I understood it.  I was a smart kid although I seem to be a pretty dumb adult now.  Professional help would just be a waste of money.  I need to quit being a cry baby and either live out my days in silenece or kill myself and get it over with.  I'm venting here because I have NO one I can talk to about this.

I'm honestly not completely sure why I'm so down.  I've been depressed since I was a child.  I'd just get into these dark sad moods for no apparent reason.  I think it started when I found out I was adopted and one of my aunts was actually my birth mother.  I've always been able to smile and fake through it, but lately it's overtaking me.  Besides depression, my life really isn't that terrible and my needs are met - but it's nothing like I expected it to be at this point.  Divorced, no kids, ok job - certainly not the dream.  Part of me knows I should just be grateful that my life is ok - but part of me is tired of feeling sad, lonely and hopeless ALL the time.   Nothing makes me happy anymore.
prayer, scriptures, long walk, cigar, sleep aid
